description:
Find cross-book arbitrage candidates from current quoted prices.

    Scans every event for quoted prices whose combined implied probability
    is under 100%. Results are candidates, not guaranteed executable profit:
    prices can move or be unavailable, and limits, latency, commissions,
    voids, settlement rules, or stake constraints can change the outcome.
    Soccer and other 3-way (home/draw/away) markets are supported, including
    candidates anchored on the draw.

    Args:
        sport_key: e.g. "baseball_mlb", "soccer_epl".
        min_profit: Minimum profit % to include (e.g. 1.5 for 1.5%). Default 0.
        exclude_exchanges: Drop arbs anchored on an exchange (novig/prophetx),
            whose asks can be no-volume. Default False.
        markets: Comma-separated market_keys to limit the scan (optional),
            e.g. "h2h,spreads,totals".
name: parlayapi_find_arbitrage
